{{Quote|Um&hellip; I'm sorry. Sir&hellip;Fett&hellip;sir. We're, ah, training new recruits, Very ''stupid'' new recruits.|A Gotal traffic controller apologizes to Jango Fett on behalf of Elmyo|<ref name="BT 1" />}}
'''Elmyo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a new recruit for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri's]] [[Atzerri Air Traffic Control|Air Traffic Control]] in the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he and his [[Unidentified Gotal traffic controller|Gotal associate]] intercepted the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] [[Slave I/Legends|ship]] after he entered Atzerri's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. Elmyo suggested that Fett begin negotiations for the landing fee, and the Gotal traffic controller immediately apologized for the man's patronization of Fett. Rather than accepting the Gotal's apology, the Mandalorian launched two [[Missile/Legends|rockets]] at the traffic control [[Starship/Legends|ship]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] Elmyo and the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Elmyo, are you ''crazy''??"''<br />"''Hey, you're going to break the comm!"''<br />"''Do you seriously not know who ''Jango Fett'' is?|Elmyo and the Gotal traffic control officer fight over their ship's comlink|<ref name="BT 1" />}}
[[File:NothisisJango.jpg|thumb|left|160px|Elmyo and his Gotal traffic associate learn that Jango Fett is controlling ''Slave I''.]]
Elmyo, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], lived during the final [[Time/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he had joined the [[Atzerri Air Traffic Control|Air Traffic Control forces]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]] and was being trained by a [[Unidentified Gotal traffic controller|Gotal traffic controller]].<ref name="BT 1" />

During that same year, Elmyo and his Gotal trainer were out on patrol, and they intercepted the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']], which belonged to the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], after it entered the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of Atzerri. After the Gotal spoke with Fett over the patrol ship's [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], Elmyo suggested that the landing fee negotiations begin, but he was interrupted when Fett revealed his identity. Elmyo, who was unaware of Fett's reputation as a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter, patronized the Mandalorian, and the Gotal took the comlink from Elmyo and apologized to Fett for Elmyo's cynical behavior. The Gotal asked Fett to provide proof of his identity; however, the bounty hunter instead launched two [[Missile/Legends|rockets]] at the traffic control ship, [[Death/Legends|killing]] Elmyo and the Gotal.<ref name="BT 1" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|This is Jango Fett."''<br />''"Great. Good. You know your own name. Now&hellip;|Fett and Elmyo|<ref name="BT 1" />}}
The Human male Elmyo was oblivious to Jango Fett's reputation as a bounty hunter and acted in a cynical manner toward the Mandalorian.<ref name="BT 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Elmyo appeared in a flashback sequence in the [[Blood Ties 1|first issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Blood Ties]]''. The comic was written by [[Tom Taylor]], illustrated by [[Chris Scalf]],<ref name="BT 1" /> and published on [[August 25]], [[2010]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54015/star_wars_blood_ties_2010_1|text=Star Wars: Blood Ties (2010) #1}}</ref>
